measure_name: Solar and renewable power for digital assets
definition: Solar or other renewable power for the digital assets a project finances or the sites it connects: solar panels or photovoltaic systems at telecom sites, schools, community centres or data centres; solar-powered equipment or kits; off-grid renewable systems with battery storage; requirements that operators or data centres use renewable energy.
note: Trial: a measure found end to end with the active-learning loop.
